title: Appointed as Assistant
original: It's just document sorting, right? Please, I do this stuff all the time, piece o' cake.

title: Talk 1
original: Doctor, come on, check out my new video. You're gonna love it.

title: Talk 2
original: Yeah, that's the icon. Mind giving it a click? Oh, and if it's not too much trouble, maybe the one right beside it too? Hehe, thanks a bunch.

title: Talk 3
original: Content! Ideas! Memes! My brain's completely blank! I'm gonna lose subs…

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: I'm just an amateur explorer, you know. I just plan to take a few shots and then come right back, so I won't be gone for long. Besides, nothing beats chilling at home sweet home.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Medical must've put some weird ideas in your head again, right? Ahhh… I admit, I get these little impulses every now and then, but I promise, I'll never cause you any real trouble.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Video editing is totally my specialty! So, Doctor, you want a Rhodes Island promo? Got a plan for me? All righty, lemme take a look. Hmm… Rhodes Island precautions, Nutrition PSAs, fire safety tutorials…What in the terra are these?!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: I have a bad feeling; there must be a terrifying Feline lurking nearby. Doctor, stay alert! They'll catch you off-guard, leap out from some shadowy corners, and smack you to the ground with a single swipe. Eh? It won't happen?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Living together with everyone and discovering new things to film—all the good things in life are compounding! Figuring all that out led me to become an operator, so now I can share my happiness with you.

title: Idle
original: Let me sneak a quick pic. Yeah, just one shot.

title: Onboard
original: 'Sup everyone, welcome to the Click Channel! Eh? No filming in the Doctor's office? Fine, I guess…

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Let me do the filming next time.

title: Promotion 1
original: A promotion? Awesome! Doctor, bring it in, let's get a commemorative photo!

title: Promotion 2
original: Re…lax… Doctor. This happens every time I get excited, but it's nothing to worry about.

title: Added to Squad
original: 'Sup, everyone!

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Leave it to me!

title: Depart
original: Doctor, don't forget to take everything you need.

title: Begin Operation
original: Let's see what interesting footage I'll get this time.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Over here!

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Tell me what to do.

title: Deployment 1
original: Fly, my drone!

title: Deployment 2
original: Let's get to work!

title: In Battle 1
original: Fire!

title: In Battle 2
original: Move aside!

title: In Battle 3
original: I see you!

title: In Battle 4
original: Hey, smile for the camera!

title: 4-star Result
original: I just got a killer clip! Make sure you come by and check it out after you get back to the landship.

title: 3-star Result
original: This is awesome! It's basically a ready–made battle record.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: I was so caught up in filming that somebody slipped by me.

title: Operation Failure
original: My lens is shattered…

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Time to open my stream studio!

title: Tap
original: Wah!

title: Trust Tap
original: Hey Doctor, I got something cool to show you!

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Oh! I just got a new idea. Hold on, where's my camera? And anywhere I can set up a tripod? Alright. Doctor, help me test this out. When the fireworks go off, just look out the window. I'll take a picture of your eyes—

title: Greeting
original: Hiii—

title: Birthday
original: Doctor, have you heard of fancams? It's when you mix a whole bunch of clips together. I sometimes catch you commanding when I'm filming battle records. Ta-dah! Doctor's Command Scene High-Energy Beat Fancam in Ultra HD! It's your birthday present!

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Doctor! I came to Rhodes Island just to earn some travel money, but there's no way I would ever leave a company that repairs my drones for free! Even with such big Felines running around, I'm not gonna— Ahhhhh! Is that… Blaze?!
